title: Team Discord Role Link
description: Link roles from your Discord Server to Minecraft teams.
body:
Have you ever used DiscordSRV and wished that you could link roles from your discord server to the players ingame? Well now you can!

This plugin makes it so players with their discord accounts linked to discordsrv can be added to teams ingame depending on the roles they have. You are able to set what team they get added to and all of the team properties.

You must edit the config file before the plugin will actually work.
Format for config at https://github.com/Verdicron/TeamDiscordRoleLink/blob/main/src/main/resources/config.yml
# Commands
```
/teamdiscordrolelink reload
```
Reloads the config file and applies any role changes.\
The command can also be run as
```
/tdrl reload
```
